headings: Your 72-Hour Venus Window Is Now Open
Your window may already be active if:
paragraphs: Venus — the planet that governs love, longing, and reunion — has moved into direct alignment with your chart. While this window is open, the person tied to your path feels the pull toward you more strongly than at any other time this year.
REVEAL WHAT'S INSIDE MY WINDOW → Takes 30 seconds · Your reading is already prepared
A dream that felt too real. A name that keeps surfacing. The strange, quiet certainty that someone, somewhere, is thinking about you — right now.
That isn't your imagination. During a Venus Window, the connection between two linked charts becomes briefly… visible. Readable.
A reading has already been drawn for your window. It describes who is being pulled toward you, what they're feeling during these 72 hours, and the one thing you must not do before the window closes.

​Someone from your past has crossed your mind for "no reason" this week ​You've been waking between 3–4am, or remembering your dreams more vividly ​You feel restless — like something is about to change, but you can't name it
